Container.Name: gogdownloader-ui
Container.Overview:
A mobile-first web UI for [a href=https://github.com/RikudouSage/GogDownloader target=_blank]RikudouSage/GogDownloader[/a], the PHP CLI that downloads the games you own on GOG.
Log in to GOG from the browser, sync your library, browse it as a grid of covers, pick exactly which installers, patches and extras you want, and watch the download progress live. Cloud saves and database backup/restore are included.
[b]Setup[/b] [olist] [*]Point [b]Downloads[/b] at the share where you want your games stored. [*]Leave [b]Config[/b] on the default appdata path — it holds the gog-downloader database with your login token and synced library, and must persist across restarts. [*]Start the container. On first start it downloads the gog-downloader CLI release from GitHub into the Config path (about 14 MB) — this needs internet access and only happens once. [*]Open the WebUI and log in to GOG using the code login. [*]Run a sync, then download whatever you like. [/olist]
[b]Note:[/b] setting a WebUI username and password is strongly recommended if the container is reachable from outside your LAN — the session is a live GOG login.
[b]Reporting a problem:[/b] Settings > About shows the UI version, the commit it was built from and the gog-downloader CLI version in use. Include those in the issue.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web interface listens on.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where downloaded installers and extras are saved.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the gog-downloader SQLite database (login token and synced library), UI settings and the cover art cache. Must persist across restarts.

Config.Name: Cloud Saves
Config.Description: Where downloaded GOG cloud saves are stored.

Config.Name: WebUI Username
Config.Description: Username for the web interface. Leave this and the password empty to run without a login (trusted LAN only).

Config.Name: WebUI Password
Config.Description: Password for the web interface. Both this and the username must be set for the login to be enforced.

Config.Name: Cover Art
Config.Description: Fetch game cover art from GOG's public product API and cache it under /config. Set to false for a text-only library with no outbound requests beyond the downloader itself.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns downloaded files. 99 is 'nobody' on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns downloaded files. 100 is 'users' on Unraid.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File mode mask applied to downloaded files.

Config.Name: Secure Cookie
Config.Description: Set to true when the UI is served over HTTPS through a reverse proxy, so the session cookie is marked Secure.

Config.Name: CLI Version
Config.Description: Release tag of RikudouSage/GogDownloader to run, e.g. v1.15.1. Leave empty to use the version this image was built against. The phar is cached under /config/cli, so changing this downloads the new version on the next start.

Config.Name: CLI Checksum
Config.Description: Optional SHA-256 of the gog-downloader release asset, verified after download. Only needed if you set CLI Version to something other than the built-in default; leave empty otherwise.
